author: Gmelin, 1789
habitat: 섬과 해안의 바위, 바닷가 바위 지대의 웅덩이, 가까운 습지
summary: 섬이나 해안의 바위에 사는 드문 텃새로, 해안과 섬 지역에서 드물게 볼 수 있다. 바닷가 바위 지대의 웅덩이나 가까운 습지에서 물고기, 게, 새우 따위를 주로 잡으며, 홀로 또는 작은 무리가 서로 거리를 두고 지낸다. 번식은 무인도나 바닷가 절벽 등에서 한다. 흑색형과 백색형이 있으나 국내에서는 아직 백색형이 기록되지 않았다.

art.subject: Pacific Reef Heron (Egretta sacra), adult dark morph (the only morph recorded in Korea), without breeding plumes: plumage uniform dark slate-grey with a bluish tinge, looking almost blackish in shade; often a small white streak on the chin and upper throat. Bill long and rather heavy, dark brownish horn, often paler on the lower mandible; bare lores greenish-yellow; iris yellow; legs dull greenish-yellow to yellow, feet yellow.
art.pose: standing on a wave-washed rock beside a tide pool, watching for fish
art.scene: Korean rocky coast of an offshore island: dark rocks, tide pools and sea cliffs; no people, buildings or text
views: adult dark morph, side view standing on a rock: uniform dark slate-grey plumage, small white chin streak, long heavy dark brown bill, yellow eye, short greenish-yellow legs
adult, head detail in side view: yellow eye, greenish-yellow lores, long heavy dark brown bill, small white chin streak
art.build: Medium-sized heron, about 60cm, smaller than a Grey Heron and similar in length to a Little Egret but more heavily built. Neck shorter and thicker than an egret's; often stands hunched and horizontal on rocks. Bill long, straight and heavy, a little longer than the head. Legs relatively short and thick for a heron, with only a short bare thigh. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail short. Flies low over the sea with slow wingbeats and the neck drawn in.
avoid: Do not paint it white; the white morph has not been recorded in Korea.
Do not give it long, thin black legs with yellow feet like a Little Egret; its legs are short, thick and yellowish.
Do not paint glossy jet-black plumage or a black bill; it is dark slate-grey with a brownish bill.
Do not draw long, thin plumes trailing from the nape.
